Escalation Matrix: Agency must provide a named escalation path with contact details for Account Director, Practice Head, and Crisis Lead. 1.2 Deliverable Turnaround SLAs • Press Release: First draft within 3 business days of brief; final version within 2 business days of feedback. • Media Pitch List: Within 3 business days of campaign brief. • Outreach Initiation: Within 2 business days of pitch approval. • Monthly Coverage Report: By 5th working day of the following month. • Weekly Flash Report: Every Monday by 12:00 PM IST. • Quarterly Communications Plan: Within 10 business days of quarter start. • Monthly Campaign Plan: Within 5 business days of month start. • Thought Leadership Article Draft: Within 7–10 business days of topic approval.

On-Time Delivery Target: ≥ 95% of agreed deliverables submitted by committed deadline. 1.3 Performance & Quality KPIs • Media Coverage: Minimum 8 quality mentions per month in target tiers (Tier-1 business dailies, leading d igital news, key fintech/finance publications). • Share of Voice (SoV) vs defined competitor set: ≥ 10% by Q4. • Sentiment: ≥ 90% positive/neutral sentiment in covered mentions. • Message Pull-Through: ≥ 90% of key messages reflected in coverage (tracked via message mapping). 1.4 Reporting & Governance SLAs • Weekly Flash Report: Key mentions, sentiment highlights, issues, upcoming opportunities. • Monthly Report: Detailed coverage (links, clippings, tier-wise breakdown, SoV, sentiment, message pull-t hrough) + SLA compliance metrics. • Quarterly Business Review (QBR): Within 10 business days of quarter end, covering performance vs KPIs, SLA score, key wins/gaps, and next-quarter plan. 1.5 Crisis & Reputation Management SLAs • Maintain an up-to-date crisis communication playbook for BOBCARD. • Activate crisis response within P0 SLA (≤ 1 hour, 24x7). • Provide 24x7 on-call support for critical issues. • Conduct 1–2 crisis simulation drills per year with BOBCARD team. 1.6 Team & Continuity SLAs • Dedicated team with named Account Director, Account Manager, Media Lead, Content Lead, and ORM/Cri sis Lead. • Minimum experience: Account Director ≥ 10 years with financial services/fintech experience. • No change in key team members without prior written approval from BOBCARD. • Replacement process must include handover plan and 2–4 week overlap period. • Meeting cadence: Weekly status call (30–45 mins), Monthly performance review (1 hour), Quarterly strat egy review (2 hours). 1.7 Penalties & Incentives (Optional) · Repeated SLA breaches (>2 consecutive months below 90% compliance) may trigger: Formal warning, f ollowed by service credit/fee adjustment (e.g., 5% of monthly retainer). · Performance bonus may be considered for exceeding KPIs significantly (e.g., SoV or quality coverage we ll above target).
